title: AXe command result, schema version 1
description: The envelope an ordinary command (one without --agent) returns with --output json. Each command's payload in data.result or data.results keeps that command's own shape and is not described here. Fields can be added within a schema version, so consumers should ignore properties they do not know.

command.description: The command name, for example tap or list-simulators.

results.description: The command's payloads, in output order, when it wrote more than one.

nextSteps.description: Reserved for guidance. Ordinary commands currently return an empty array.
